translation: Rehmannia sprout (地黃苗), di song (地菘), artemisia (青蒿), cocklebur sprout (蒼耳苗), red peony (赤芍藥, decocted in water to extract the juice, each five liang), raw mugwort juice (生艾汁, three ge). Prepare the above on the fifth day of the fifth month and the seventh day of the seventh month at noon; mix the previous medicinal juices with lime, dry in the shade, add three liang of yellow lead (黃丹), and pound further into a fine powder. In all cases of injury and fracture with bleeding, wrap and seal with the medicine and do not move it; in about ten days it will heal, without swelling or pus. <ins>Fu Rong Ointment (芙蓉膏)</ins> Treats injuries from falls and blows, with swelling, pain, and blue-purple color that does not recede for a long time.
